record.field: SELECT code as "Concepto", SUM(B) AS "Saldos al -31-18" FROM ( SELECT mml.code, (CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'B' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN SUM(aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'B' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN SUM(aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'B' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN SUM(aml.debit-aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'B' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN SUM(aml.tax_base_amount) END ) as B FROM mag_media mm INNER JOIN mag_media_lines mml ON mml.magnetic_id = mm.id INNER JOIN mag_media_lines_concepts mmlc ON mmlc.line_id = mml.id INNER JOIN ( select aammlcr.account_account_id as account_id, aammlcr.mag_media_lines_concepts_id as concept_id FROM account_account_mag_media_lines_concepts_rel aammlcr UNION ALL select aaat.account_account_id as account_id, mmlcaat.concept_ids as concept_id from mag_media_lines_concepts_account_account_tag mmlcaat INNER JOIN account_account_tag aat on aat.id = mmlcaat.tag_ids INNER JOIN account_account_account_tag aaat on aaat.account_account_tag_id = aat.id ) AS aa ON aa.concept_id = mmlc.id INNER JOIN account_move_line aml ON aml.account_id = aa.account_id WHERE mm.id = {id} AND aml.date BETWEEN '{date_from}' AND '{date_to}' AND aml.parent_state = 'posted' AND aml.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY mml.code, mmlc.sequence, mmlc.type, mm.smaller_amount -- HAVING (CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'B' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN SUM(aml.debit) -- WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'B' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN SUM(aml.credit) -- WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'B' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN SUM(aml.debit-aml.credit) -- WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'B' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN SUM(aml.tax_base_amount) END)::float >= mm.smaller_amount::float ) as datos GROUP BY code
